_README: GitHub App manifest for Skylize. integration_inputs.md 2.4, APPROVED 2026-09-05.
THIS FILE IS TIER 1. The 'default_permissions' block below is the entire
Tier 1 guarantee of the 2.4 architecture, expressed as data rather than as
code, so it can be reviewed and diffed rather than traced through call
sites. What is ABSENT matters more than what is present:
administration  ABSENT -> repository deletion is IMPOSSIBLE, and so is
editing the branch-protection rulesets that Tier 2 relies
on. Verified live 2026-09-05: DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}
requires administration:write, a DIFFERENT permission from
contents. Never requesting it is what makes repo deletion
structurally impossible rather than merely gated - there is
no gate to refactor away because the capability is never
minted.
secrets         ABSENT -> repository secrets cannot be read or written.
actions         ABSENT -> workflow runs and Actions variables cannot be
touched.
environments    ABSENT -> environment secrets cannot be touched.
A future editor adding any of those four is reversing an owner decision and
silently removing the strongest guarantee in the GitHub design. Do not do it
without a new integration_inputs.md 2.4 approval. tests/unit/
test_github_app_manifest.py asserts this file's permission set exactly and
will fail if it drifts.
WHY contents IS write AND NOT read. A pull request needs a head branch with
commits on it, and creating that branch is contents:write - verified live
2026-09-05: POST/PATCH /repos/{o}/{r}/git/refs and POST .../git/commits are
all contents:write. There is no contents:write-except-delete, so this single
permission unavoidably also permits deleting a ref and merging a PR. That is
exactly why 2.4 Q2.4b.2 chose verb-surface minimalism: Skylize never builds
a delete-branch verb at all, so the token's theoretical capability is
unreachable by any agent.
default_events is deliberately EMPTY this pass. The uninstall webhook
(2.4 Q2.4e) is approved but NOT built yet, and subscribing to an event with
no endpoint to receive it would only generate failing deliveries. The
'installation' event is added in the same pass that adds the ingress.
url/redirect_url are placeholders an operator replaces at registration time;
scripts/register_github_app.py substitutes them.
name: Skylize
description: Skylize governs AI-agent actions. This App lets a Skylize agent open pull requests against repositories you select. It deliberately cannot delete repositories, cannot change your branch protection rules, and cannot read or write your secrets.
